scope: Nineteen unchanged canonical compiler routes; five explicitly audited named layout extensions. All retain exact canonical prompt, ART_KIT and DiscoveryAtlas style input, with recorded composition/source-visibility additions. Painting requests are not observed anatomy. No runtime, registered pack, reference pool or native qualification.

entries.name: Zebra
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: bold black-white stripes continue over body, belly and all four visible legs; upright brush mane, both ears, bare upper tail shaft and full dark tail tuft are retained. Four hooves are separated, but far upper limb roots remain partially behind the near limbs/body. Tail is continuous and clear of the hind feet. No authoring or motion claim.

entries.name: Kudu
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: two towering corkscrew horns, both large rounded ear blades, multiple thin white flank stripes, pale facial chevron, real throat fringe and full tufted tail are visible. Four separate hoof endpoints; far upper limbs remain partly occluded. Horn tips approach the top edge, so framing is held for the unchanged observer. Ear roots and horn bases overlap naturally rather than receiving invented gaps.

entries.name: Impala
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: ringed lyre horns, black rump stripes, white belly and real black hind-hoof tufts are visible. ANATOMY REFUSAL: five full leg/hoof endpoints are painted, including three foreleg-like shafts below the chest, despite the four-leg request. Do not remove or relabel the extra leg locally or admit this source. Horn tips also approach the top margin. The failed one-attempt original is retained unchanged.

entries.name: Eland
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: massive ox-like shoulder hump, tightly spiral horns, large real dewlap, both ears and complete tail shaft/tuft are visible. Four hoof endpoints are distinct, though both upper foreleg roots remain close and partly overlapped beneath the chest. Horns and ear roots are connected; no hidden anatomy or motion admission is inferred.

entries.name: Gazelle
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: tan upper body, dark flank band above white belly, ringed slender horns, both actual ear blades, short complete dark-tipped tail and four separate hooves are visible. Far ear base is partly behind the horn, and upper far leg emergence remains naturally occluded; no false full-chain proof. All pigment bands are retained.

entries.name: Hartebeest
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: long narrow face, high shoulders and rearward-sloping back, ringed bracket-like horns, both ear blades, full tufted tail and four hoof endpoints are visible. The exact bony horn pedestal and skull proportions remain an identity review hold. Upper foreleg roots partly overlap; no inferred hidden structures.

entries.name: Oryx
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: unshortened swept-back straight horns, black face mask, dark leg markings, both visible ear tips, full natural tail and four separated hoof endpoints are visible. Near ear blade is readable beside the horn base. Top horn margin is tight; far ear root and upper limb attachments remain partly occluded. No inferred hidden anatomy.

entries.name: Gaur
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: dark muscular body, tall shoulder ridge, white stockings on all four separate legs, pale grey forehead, upcurving horns, both ear edges and complete tufted tail are visible. Body/forehead are turned somewhat toward the viewer; far upper leg roots remain occluded. Muzzle approaches the right edge, with framing held for measurement; shoulder/horn proportions still require anatomical review.

entries.name: Deer
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: branched sweeping antlers, two large cupped ear blades, slender brown body with pale underside, actual short white-backed tail and four separated hoof endpoints. Tail stays short and complete rather than extended to a reference length. Antler/ear bases and proximal far limbs remain partly occluded; no per-part presence admission.

entries.name: Antelope
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: unbranched ringed horns, tan flank and white belly, short complete flicking tail, both ear tips and four separate hoof endpoints are visible. Near/far foreleg shafts overlap for part of their length below the chest, so full independent root-to-foot proof remains held. The generic impala/gazelle-type identity is retained, not asserted as a specific unseen subspecies.

entries.name: Reindeer
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: four separate hoof endpoints, dark brown/cream mottled body, pale neck ruff, short white tail and large antlers with forward brow shovel. Antler tops remain heavily palmated and exaggerated, so the earlier moose-like identity/proportion issue is not claimed resolved. Only the near ear is clearly distinguishable; the far ear remains obscured by head/antlers. Far proximal limb roots partly overlap the torso. The right antler is close to the canvas edge; unchanged framing observer is pending. No hidden anatomy inferred.

entries.name: Caribou
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: four hoof endpoints, lean brown/white body, pale neck ruff, short white tail, sweeping antler beams with forward shovel. Broad palmated tops remain stylized and require identity/proportion review. Near ear is clear but far ear is obscured. Forelegs are close together and overlap proximally; four independent complete support chains are not established by visible endpoints alone. Framing observer is pending. No hidden roots, joints or ear invented.

entries.name: Yak
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: four exposed hoof endpoints, long natural shaggy coat, shoulder hump, upcurved horns, long fully haired tail and visible near ear. The coat still hides much of the knee/ankle/root anatomy; no cleared coat or inferred limb chains are claimed. Far ear is not independently legible. Horn and tail approach side margins; unchanged framing observer decides. Tail coat and pale shoulder coloration require species/style review.

entries.name: Takin
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: four separately visible hoof endpoints, golden shaggy coat, robust body, blunt dark muzzle, swept curved horns and short natural tail. Near ear is legible; far ear remains hidden behind horns/head. Proximal far legs overlap body/near legs and coat conceals upper boundaries. Source is held for actual root/contact authoring and proportions; endpoints do not establish four complete chains. No anatomy removed to force the template.

entries.name: Sheep
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: white wool coat, two visible ear tips and four separate hoof endpoints. The wool-covered tail still hangs well down from the rump, so the canonical short-tail correction is not claimed resolved. Wool obscures proximal limb boundaries and tail root. No clipped coat, hidden leg inference or absent-horn interpretation is used. Right muzzle margin appears tight; observer pending.

entries.name: Wild Sheep
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: brown/cream coarse coat, white rump, very short dark tail, large curled horns and four exposed hoof endpoints. Near ear is visible inside horn curve; far ear is hidden. The far foreleg emerges from body/near shoulder overlap, so complete independent roots remain an authoring hold. Horn proportions and species identity require review. Visible dewclaws are retained as actual source pixels rather than extra walking legs.

entries.name: Dromedary Camel
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: one hump, long neck, two visible ear tips, four separate feet with paired toes, visible leg callosities and a continuous tufted tail clear of the hind feet. Foreleg roots still partly overlap the chest, so four complete independently observable chains are not assumed. Some dark round callosity placements and limb proportions require species review. Muzzle is close to right edge; unchanged observer decides framing.

entries.name: Bactrian Camel
entries.visualHolds: Full-size native original inspected: two separate humps, natural shaggy neck coat, four exposed foot endpoints with paired toes and a continuous tufted tail. Near ear is distinct but far ear remains concealed. Coat and near-side shoulder obscure far limb roots; no hidden upper parts are inferred. Distinct hump count and tail silhouette are preserved, while exact leg contact, anatomy and authoring remain unmeasured.

entries.name: Gibbon
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: tailless ape with arms much longer than legs, long hooked fingers, light face surround and two natural feet. Two arm chains and two leg chains are visible, but the far upper leg is partly overlapped by the near arm. Hands and feet lie at different image heights and one hand hangs above the implied support plane; no four-ground-contact or exact digit-count claim. Three-quarter view rather than strict side profile.

entries.name: Leech
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: one continuous ringed arch with a larger left posterior sucker rim and smaller right anterior rim, no limbs or visible facial eyes. Both ends are visible, but the body is rather cylindrical and the sucker cavities are deep/fluted rather than a plainly flattened leech; this anatomy/proportion hold remains. No claim that a tube lumen extends through the animal.

entries.name: Sea Squirt
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: one translucent leathery sac, two separate raised siphon openings and a visible internal basket-like structure. The attached base is painted as irregular root-like tissue; its biological form and prominent internal lattice need review. Both real apertures are retained despite the coarse template's single aperture chain; neither is relabeled or deleted.

entries.name: Banana Slug
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: bright yellow shellless body, mantle saddle with breathing hole, broad continuous foot/sole, two upper eye-bearing stalks and two shorter lower tentacles are visible. Mouth fold is only a small shaded crease below the head, not a fully separable mouth aperture. Right ocular stalk approaches the margin. No shell or extra limbs invented; biological shell absence is not a production reviewed-presence declaration.

entries.name: Prawn
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: transparent segmented carapace/abdomen, toothed rostrum, two stalked eyes, very long antennae, shorter antennules, attached feathery swimmerets and complete tail fan are visible. Multiple walking-leg chains are separated, but far proximal roots overlap near the thorax; all ten cannot yet be independently traced. One antenna approaches the right margin. Real swimmerets/head appendages remain intact, not deleted to fit the template.

entries.name: Crab
entries.visualHolds: Full-size original: broad chitin carapace, two stalked eyes, mouthparts and two open claws with palms/fixed fingers/dactyls are visible. Several walking limbs are distinct on each side, but rear chains are partly hidden behind the carapace and other legs. Eight complete independent walking paths are not confidently visible; no concealed last-pair inference. One bounded original remains held for anatomy/reference review.
